limitations: Full Minecraft client with the user modpack was not launched.
FPS improvement must be measured on the user server.
Offline bytecode validation used Sponge Mixin 0.8.7 and ASM 9.11 under Java 25 through legacy LaunchWrapper; this is not a Fabric game launch.
Frame cache only covers normal block_display model preparation, not GPU costs or all item models.
displayRenderDistance defaults to 18 blocks. Zero retains the original render distance. Existing explicit configuration values are preserved.
The config factory was created against the real Mod Menu API, but the full screen was not opened in a running Minecraft client.
Occlusion uses the installed Entity Culling mod and its asynchronous update schedule and transparency settings.
Unknown or animated item-model bounds and moving entity anchors retain visibility for conservative behavior.
Full occlusion behavior with the user server resource pack and shader pack must be tested in the client.
The Mod Menu icon and translated strings were verified in packaged resources and the real 21.0.0 API bytecode; the full Mod Menu screen was not opened in a running client.
Automatic settings transfer requires a unique sibling .properties file with all seven recognized keys; ambiguous or incomplete configurations can be renamed manually before first launch.
GitHub update selection is covered by offline fixtures; the full Mod Menu notification and three settings tabs still need an in-game check.
